notes: Rome is walkable; metro lines A and B are limited, and bus 64 goes to the Vatican. The Leonardo Express to Fiumicino costs 14 EUR. The Roma Pass (48/72 hours) covers museums and transport.
Timed online tickets are ESSENTIAL for the Colosseum, Vatican Museums and Borghese; book Borghese weeks ahead and the Vatican 60 days ahead.
Winter is 8-14°C and rainy, but without the crowds; the Colosseum and Vatican are calm, Piazza Navona has its Christmas market, and January brings sales.
Rome's four pastas: carbonara, cacio e pepe, amatriciana, gricia; the coperto (cover charge) is 2-3 EUR, and tipping means rounding up.
Cover shoulders and knees in churches (the Vatican is strict); the fountains (nasoni) give drinkable water, so refill your bottle.
Watch for pickpockets on bus 64 and at Termini; say 'no grazie' to bracelet sellers at Trevi and the Spanish Steps.

stops.name: Colosseo
stops.tips: One ticket covers the Colosseum, Forum and Palatine Hill (about 18 EUR); book the 08:30 first slot online. The arena floor costs extra, there is no shade, so bring water.

stops.name: Foro Romano
stops.tips: Included in the same ticket; walk along the Via Sacra and see the Temple of Vesta.

stops.name: Palatino
stops.tips: Imperial palace ruins and views over the Forum; there is an orange grove.

stops.name: Trattoria Luzzi
stops.tips: A cheap, no-frills local trattoria next to the Colosseum; try the cacio e pepe. The queue moves fast.

stops.name: Piazza del Campidoglio
stops.tips: Michelangelo's square; the terrace behind it gives a free sunset view over the Forum.

backups.name: Li Rioni Pizzeria
backups.tips: Roman-style pizza near the Colosseum; open in the evening.

backups.name: Basilica di San Clemente
backups.tips: A three-level church built over a Roman temple; right next to the Colosseum.

stops.name: Musei Vaticani
stops.tips: Book the 08:00 first slot for the Sistine Chapel (25 EUR online, bookable 60 days ahead); expect the Raphael Rooms and long corridors.

stops.name: Basilica di San Pietro
stops.tips: Free to enter, but there is a security queue; the dome costs 10 EUR (551 steps), and the Pietà is by the entrance.

stops.name: Bonci Pizzarium
stops.tips: Gabriele Bonci's pizza by the slice; near Cipro metro station for the Vatican, eat standing up.

stops.name: Castel Sant'Angelo
stops.tips: Hadrian's mausoleum turned fortress; the terrace has views toward the Vatican.

stops.name: Ponte Sant'Angelo
stops.tips: Bernini's bridge lined with angels; photograph it before sunset.

backups.name: Pizzeria Da Remo Testaccio
backups.tips: Thin Roman pizza; evenings, in Testaccio.

backups.name: Giardini Vaticani
backups.tips: Guided tour of the Vatican Gardens; an alternative to the castle.

days.theme: Baroque Rome: Pantheon, Navona and Trevi

stops.name: Pantheon
stops.tips: See the oculus in the dome; entry is 5 EUR, the morning light is best, and Mass is held on Sundays.

stops.name: Piazza Navona
stops.tips: Bernini's Fountain of the Four Rivers; the cafes are pricey, so come for the photos.

stops.name: Campo de' Fiori
stops.tips: Morning market with cheese, spices and truffle products.

stops.name: Roscioli Salumeria
stops.tips: Carbonara and a deli counter display; booking is essential, and it is among the best in Rome.

stops.name: Trevi Fountain
stops.tips: Toss in a coin; it is empty at 07:00 or 23:00 and swamped by day (entry system in place since 2025).

backups.name: Armando al Pantheon
backups.tips: Roman cooking since 1961; next to the Pantheon, book ahead.

backups.name: Galleria Doria Pamphilj
backups.tips: A private palace collection with Caravaggio and Velázquez; a calm alternative to Trevi.

stops.name: Santa Maria in Trastevere
stops.tips: One of Rome's oldest churches dedicated to Mary; golden mosaics, and quiet in the morning.

stops.name: Trastevere Streets
stops.tips: Cobblestones and ivy-covered walls; stroll Via della Lungaretta.

stops.name: Da Enzo al 29
stops.tips: A small Trastevere classic; amatriciana and artichokes. Join the queue when it opens at 12:00.

stops.name: Villa Farnesina
stops.tips: A Renaissance villa with Raphael frescoes; peaceful.

stops.name: Janiculum Terrace
stops.tips: Rome's best free view; the Garibaldi monument, and sunset.

backups.name: Trapizzino Trastevere
backups.tips: Stew stuffed in a pizza pocket; street food.

backups.name: Orto Botanico di Roma
backups.tips: A botanical garden in Trastevere; an alternative to the villa.

stops.name: Galleria Borghese
stops.tips: Bernini sculptures and Caravaggio; 2-hour slots, and booking weeks ahead is mandatory.

stops.name: Villa Borghese Gardens
stops.tips: Walk through the park; the Pincio terrace overlooks Piazza del Popolo.

stops.name: Spanish Steps
stops.tips: Sitting on the steps is banned; Via Condotti is nearby.

stops.name: Pastificio Guerra
stops.tips: Fresh pasta for 5 EUR just behind the Spanish Steps; there is a queue at 13:00.

stops.name: Ara Pacis
stops.tips: Augustus's altar of peace, housed in Richard Meier's glass pavilion; air-conditioned.

backups.name: Ginger Sapori e Salute
backups.tips: A light Italian lunch near the Spanish Steps.

backups.name: Piazza del Popolo
backups.tips: Twin churches and a Caravaggio (Santa Maria del Popolo, free).

stops.name: Villa d'Este
stops.tips: Renaissance fountain gardens in Tivoli; 500 jets, and open in winter too.

stops.name: Sibilla Ristorante Tivoli
stops.tips: A historic restaurant beside the Temple of Vesta; views over Tivoli.

stops.name: Villa Adriana
stops.tips: Hadrian's vast villa; the Canopus pool, and a 2-hour walk.

backups.name: Castelli Romani Frascati
backups.tips: A wine town in the hills outside Rome; an alternative to Ostia.

stops.name: Mercato Testaccio
stops.tips: Local market; try the beef stew sandwich at Mordi e Vai, and supplì (fried rice balls).

stops.name: Pyramid of Cestius and Non-Catholic Cemetery
stops.tips: A pyramid in Rome and the Keats-Shelley cemetery; look out for the cats.

stops.name: Aventine Orange Garden
stops.tips: Giardino degli Aranci and the Knights of Malta keyhole; a farewell view.

stops.name: Flavio al Velavevodetto
stops.tips: A trattoria carved into Monte Testaccio; carbonara and coda alla vaccinara (oxtail stew).

stops.name: Roma Termini
stops.tips: The Leonardo Express reaches Fiumicino in 32 minutes; time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Trapizzino Testaccio
backups.tips: Stew stuffed in a pizza pocket; a quick farewell bite.

backups.name: Baths of Caracalla
backups.tips: Ruins of a huge Roman bathhouse; an alternative to the pyramid.
